title: Opus 5.5 Mech/RTS game trailer
author: Reasonable-Reason901
selftext:
I took opus 5.5 this weekend and combined 2 of my previously abandoned games I was working on with fable that never felt good enough to finish. 

One was an RTS where you can call in stratagem style abilities like helldivers, the other was a horde shooter mech action game. 

This game is my attempt at combining the 2 where the idea is you can shift seamlessly between the role of commander and pilot to play around the high level direction and strategy placing defensive structures, choosing units to build and dropping air support, while also having the ability to pilot a hero style mech that takes specific objectives and helps with pushing and focusing targets. 

While you pilot the mech, an AI commander takes over and handles producing your units, commanding units to take objectives, offering air support which can be requested directly while piloting. 

While you command, an AI pilots the mech and fights autonomously and can be ordered to fly to a specific objective or target an enemy. 

Admittedly, most of the focus has been on the mech gameplay first which the trailer kind of leans into. The idea is to allow players to play whichever they want and make the AI smart enough to carry both roles, while each allow some amount of agency over the other while not disrupting the current one you play (while piloting the mech, calling in air support is a simple point and click to drop a beacon that also routes units to support the area). 

I used 2 20x weekly quotas with a mix of high/max effort. The game is built on three.js and Opus 5.5 did all of the modeling by hand via blender mcp which still leaves a lot to be desired but it’s such a night and day difference from earlier models where I finally feel content enough to post progress (I worked on maybe 7-8 games before this that I never ended up finishing) and maybe even commit to a launch date next year.

If you have feedback or any questions please share, thanks for reading.
